stories.headline: Blake got married this weekend and posted 187.04
stories.body:
Blake got married this weekend. Chop Wood, Carry Water scored 187.04, the highest total in the league, and beat F&F: Tokyo Swift 187.04 to 111.84.

He also, finally, started Patrick Mahomes. Two weeks of this desk pointing at a quarterback sitting on his bench for 26.7 and then 34.98, and the week he fixed it is the week he had somewhere else to be. Mahomes returned 20.94 and was only the fifth-highest scorer on his own team — Bijan Robinson went for 35.30, Juwan Johnson 23.30, Kyren Williams 21.80 and Davante Adams 20.70, against a roster projection of 137.7.

Chop Wood, Carry Water are 3-0, first in the standings, first in the power rankings, and carry a 97% playoff estimate with a 55% chance of the top seed. Both are the highest anybody has held this season. Congratulations to the couple, and condolences to a marriage that is three days old and already sharing a house with the best team in this league.

takes.text: I have been on teams where a man got married in season and the whole locker room knew he had not thought about football in a week. Blake set the best lineup he has set all year. I do not know what that says about him and I am not sure his wife wants to hear it, but 187.04 is 187.04.

HE STARTED MAHOMES! I have been screaming about this quarterback for two weeks, TWO WEEKS, and the man finally starts him in the week he is getting MARRIED! Where was this in week one! I want to know who got to him and I want to send them a gift!

First in the standings, first in the rankings, and the only man on this desk who picked them is me. I said fourth was where you hide a team you are afraid to defend. Everybody in this building was afraid. I was at the wedding in spirit and I was right on the record.

Forty-nine points over projection, which is the largest overage on the board, and still only 85% lineup efficiency with 69.0 unstarted — Michael Wilson at 25.90 and Kenyon Sadiq at 23.50 among it. He is winning by a margin wide enough that the bench does not matter yet. It will.

A man gets married and scores a hundred and eighty-seven. That is not a coincidence, that is a documented phenomenon, and I have been saying for years that this league does not account for a manager's personal circumstances. Somebody get the rest of these people engaged. Write it down.

stories.storyline: Is 187.04 the ceiling for Chop Wood, Carry Water, or the week the rest of the league starts planning around them?

stories.headline: Stephen B Smith's championship pick scored 95.56
stories.body:
Team Carlzyn were projected for 136.9 and scored 95.56, losing to Egbukkake by 52.50. It is the lowest total Mason has posted, after 168.0 and 142.1 in the first two weeks.

Jonathan Taylor returned 9.20 of a projected 19.9 and David Montgomery 6.80 of 14.4. Trey Smack kicked for 1.00 and the Seattle defense produced 2.00. Josh Allen, carrying a knee designation, returned 19.46 of 26.8 — the one number on the sheet with an explanation attached.

Mason also traded for TreVeyon Henderson this week and started him for 3.90, while Keenan Allen scored 18.30 on the bench. Team Carlzyn are 2-1 and fifth in the power rankings. Stephen B Smith picked them to win the championship.

takes.text: NINETY-FIVE POINT FIVE SIX. I said this roster's ceiling was a number nobody in this league had seen. I did not say anything about the FLOOR! And I am not moving off it, because I cannot, because that is the entire point of the exercise!

Forty-one points under projection with an 88% lineup efficiency. This is not a management failure, it is six starters missing at once, and the only one of them with a designation beside his name is the quarterback who outscored everybody else on the team. Some weeks the roster simply does not turn up.

He traded for a running back and started him for three point nine. He benched Keenan Allen for eighteen. And he is going to be on this desk tomorrow telling us Carlzyn is still the pick, which is the only part of this I respect.

stories.storyline: Is Carlzyn's 95.56 a one-week collapse, or the week the ceiling argument stopped being interesting?

stories.headline: The commissioner finally won one, and did it with 11.36 from his quarterback and his lead back
stories.body:
Egbukkake scored 148.06 and beat Team Carlzyn by 52.50. It is comfortably Adam's best week — 121.5, then 117.0, now 148.1 — and it came with Drake Maye returning 5.76 of a projected 21.1 and Omarion Hampton 5.60 of 14.1.

Everything else worked. Garrett Wilson went for 26.70, George Kittle 26.20, CeeDee Lamb 20.20 and Harrison Mevis kicked 16.00. Mike Evans, listed out with ribs, still produced 12.40.

It was also his cleanest lineup of the year: 90% efficiency with 27.7 unstarted, against 86% and 37.4 a week ago. Egbukkake are 1-2 with a 34% playoff estimate, up from 12% seven days ago.

takes.text: Eleven points from your quarterback and your lead back and you win by fifty-two. That is a roster with depth, which is a different thing from a roster that has been unlucky, and it is the first evidence all season that Adam has one.

Twelve percent to thirty-four percent in one week. I have been telling this desk that two weeks is not a season and everybody looked at the floor. The commissioner is alive and I would like that entered into the record I am apparently keeping.

He runs the paper and he finally has something to print about himself that is not humiliating! One hundred and forty-eight! And he STILL has the second-hardest schedule faced in this league, which he will absolutely mention, because he built the number.

stories.storyline: Does Adam's 34% survive a real schedule, or was Carlzyn's collapse the whole story?

stories.headline: Darrien left 102.0 points on his bench and is 0-3
stories.body:
Dsteady1234 scored 95.08 against a projection of 130.2 and left 102.0 points unstarted, the most in the league. Matthew Stafford scored 26.90 on the bench, Jordan Addison 20.00, Luther Burden 19.80 and Keaton Mitchell 13.70.

The lineup he did start returned 76% of what was available, also the worst in the league and the third week running he has finished last on that measure. The New England defense scored minus 1.00. De'Von Achane, now on injured reserve with a knee, returned 1.70.

Darrien is 0-3 with an all-play record of 3-30 and a 1% playoff estimate. No other team in this league is below 4%.

takes.text: A hundred and two points unstarted. To put that in scale, it is more than the entire winning score in two matchups this week. The Achane situation is genuinely bad luck and I will not count it against him, but Stafford, Addison and Burden are sixty-six points he chose not to start.

Three and thirty on all-play. Not three and thirty in the standings, on all-play, which means that across three weeks and thirty-three opportunities he has beaten three teams. There is no schedule bad enough to produce that. That is a roster and a Sunday morning.

He lost his lead back to a knee and that is a real thing to lose. But the rest of it is fixable in forty minutes on a Sunday morning, and the longer a man goes without fixing it the more it stops looking like bad luck and starts looking like a decision.

stories.storyline: Does Darrien start setting lineups, or is 0-3 already the season?

stories.headline: Boesch traded for Tyler Shough, benched him for 32.80, and won anyway
stories.body:
The Shortbus Superstars traded TreVeyon Henderson to Team Carlzyn for Tyler Shough this week. Shough scored 32.80 on the bench. Jordan Love started at quarterback and scored 23.48. Henderson scored 3.90 for his new team.

It did not cost Boesch anything. The Shortbus Superstars scored 140.08 — their best week by some distance after 100.6 and 104.1 — and beat I HURT MY NABERS 140.08 to 113.22. Brock Bowers went for 27.60 and Terry McLaurin 19.70 against a 9.8 projection.

They are 1-2, eleventh in the power rankings and on a 4% playoff estimate. Fat McCafferty picked them to win the championship when they were called something else.

takes.text: A hundred and forty. Best week in the league that nobody will write about because of the name on the front of it. I picked this team when the room laughed and the room is quieter this morning. Eleventh is a place, not a verdict. Write it down.

He traded for a quarterback and did not start him. The man he traded him for scored three point nine. Both sides of that trade have now failed in the same week, which is the most this league has ever agreed on anything.

stories.storyline: Does Shough start next week, and does 140.08 mean anything at 4%?
